CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
May 7, 2025 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minute(s) approval for April 2, 2025, Planning Commission meeting.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Keokia Childress
  representing Strips n’ Dips for Special Use Permit No. 25-00005
  (SUP25-00005) to allow the sale of beer, wine, and distilled
  spirits for on-site consumption for an existing fast food
  restaurant on an H-C (Historic Core) zoned property at 128 North
  Market Street.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2025-038) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City Hall and via email at al-martell@cityofinglewood.org.
  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1)Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2025-038;
  2)Adopt the resolution approving SUP25-00005.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Alchemy Planning
  plus Land Use for Zone Change No. 23-00002 (ZC23-00002) to allow
  a Zone Change of 2 parcels from MU-1 (Mixed Use 1) to M-1 (Light
  Manufacturing) and a portion of 3 parcels from M-1 (Light
  Manufacturing) to MU-1 (Mixed Use 1). The Zone Change request
  encompasses 3.99  acres (200-308 East Beach Avenue). No
  specific development application has been submitted associated
  with the zone change request.

  Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Addendum to the EIR, EA-EIR-2016-44;
  2) Adopt the resolution recommending approval to the City
  Council of ZC23-00002.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
   C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6b Documents

  c. A public hearing to consider an application by East Beach
  Inglewood, LLC for Zone Change No. 23-00003 (ZC23-00003) to
  allow a zone change of 14 parcels from M-1 (Light Manufacturing)
  and R-2 (Limited Multiple-family Residential) to MU-1 (Mixed Use
  1). The Zone Change request encompasses 2.93-acres (326-366 East
  Beach Avenue and 333-375 La Colina Drive). There is no specific
  development application associated with the zone change request.

  Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Addendum to the EIR, EA-EIR-2016-44;
  2) Adopt the resolution recommending approval to the City
  Council of ZC23-00003
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6c Documents

  d. A public hearing to consider an application by Plymouth
  Inglewood Development LLC, for Special Use Permit No. 25-
  00009(SUP25-00009) to amend the amenity area and architectural
  treatments approved under a Planned Assembly Development (PAD)
  SP-2018-008  on  an  R-3/P-1  (Multiple-family  Residential)
  /(Automobile Parking) zoned property located at 113-133 West
  Plymouth Street.

  Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Adopt the resolution approving SUP25-00009.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6d Documents

7.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

8.  Commission Initiatives.

9.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

  2
 In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of May 7, 2025, is not
held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item
being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item
will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 4, 2025, AT 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
